revenue.label: revenue
revenue.missing: What was your revenue for {start} through {end}, in {currency}? Please separate recurring and one-time revenue if that distinction explains the change.
revenue.conflict: The attached readings give different information for revenue. Please review the values and sources shown and tell us which is correct, or provide a correction. Include currency, units and the relevant dates.
revenue.reader_missing: Only one reading found revenue. Can you confirm it from the source shown, or provide the correct information?
revenue.uncertain: We could not read or verify revenue reliably. Please confirm the information and its dates, or upload a clearer document.
revenue.period: The available revenue does not clearly match this request. Please provide information for {start} through {end}.
revenue.clarify: Please review revenue and provide the correct information for this report. Include amount, currency, units and reporting dates.

revenue.units: Is the revenue shown in whole currency units, thousands or millions? Please provide the amount in whole units.
